identification.value: PB: 15.00 in wide (up to 225 A) or 21.00 in wide (up to 400 A); branch breakers in two vertical cutouts 7.00 in side to side; tan or gray handles (CH/CHB).

PH: 21.00 in wide (up to 600 A) or 26.00 in wide (up to 800 A); CH, CHB, F and C-frame breakers in a single cutout 14.25 in across; branch space in "B" increments (4 poles 1-ph / 6 poles 3-ph). PH-L/NFB(21 in): two vertical cutouts 14.25 in across, F-frame, black handles, up to 225 A.

Cutler-Hammer Type EP plug-in power panelboard

ed_dual_plug_on_units.value: Type ED dual plug-on units (one or two 3-pole EHD/FDB/FD/HFD/FDC 15-225 A or ED/EDH/EDC 100-225 A breakers on one adapter, 3X, with cover plate, hardware, instructions) are ordered by description, not catalog number; a blank wireway filler plate is required when mounted in a double bus panel.

identification.value: EP/ES: 30.00, 42.00 or 48.00 in wide enclosures; up to 1200 A main breaker or 800 A main fusible switch or 1200 A MLO; breakers/switches without metal side flanges; breaker covers attached to the trim. 1X = 1.38 in. Box heights 64/75/86 in (24X-80X).

NFB (26.50-36.00 in wide), CDP, MP40: 30.00 or 38.00 in wide enclosures, up to 1200 A main breaker or fusible switch or 1600 A MLO; F- through L-frame twin-mounted horizontal with center cover between breakers. MP100: fusible switches labelled M50 30-1200 A.

leads.topic: PL01400003E / PL01400001E / PL01400002E price lists still not obtained
leads.detail: RP01400003E (now obtained) says pricing is in PL01400003E (discount symbol CE9). Wesco and Carlton-Bates mirrors return 403 to curl and WebFetch; guessed cooperindustries.com DAM paths 404. Price lists would give the full enumerated KMP40*/KPH*/KPH-L*/EE2 unit and MP40FC-nX/MP100FC-nX numbers.

leads.detail: OEM Table 22 lists MP40KF100-2/-3, MP40KF225-2/-3, MP40KC225-2/-3, MP40KCHH225-2/-3, MP40KJ225-3, MP40KK400-3, MP40KL600-3, MP40KLL400-3, MP40KM800-3, MP40KN1200-3; fillers MP40FC-nX. Dealer numbers may be pre-2013 Sumter numbers (an earlier RP01400003E edition or PL01400003E Jan 2008 would settle it).

leads.topic: RP01400003E typesetting anomalies to confirm with Sumter (803-481-6677)
leads.detail: 39-3613-16 and 39-3613-27 (all other PB/PH deadfront kits are 99-3613-xx); bare "99-3613" for PH 42-pole 400 A MLO; EEFBP6T2 / EEFBP10T2 vs EEFPB pattern; PB row "30 poles 255 A" (probably 225 A); PB 15 in MLO 3-ph 30 poles "225 400" A.

leads.topic: Pow-R-Line C / Pow-R-Line i switchboard branch connector or provision kit catalog numbers - still none found
leads.detail: No PRL-C/PRLi branch connector kit numbers appear in IM01500001E, CA08104001E Tab 21, or Eaton skuPages; distributor (automa.net) "KPRL3AED3POA" naming as PRL-C is unverified. PRL-C distribution sections use panelboard-type (PRL4) chassis; KPRL4* kits may apply but no OEM statement found. Ask Sumter aftermarket.

Eaton web: PDSPD4803SA2A-K3 = RSPF F-frame SPD "with KPRL3AFD3 Provision Kit"; -K4 = "with KPRL4FD Provision Kit". Only K3/K4 variants exist (K1/K2/K5/K6 404). Need the RSPF/PDSPD instruction leaflet for mounting details; datasheet link https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/skuPage.RSPF4803SA2A-K3.pdf.

PRL3a GB 24-circuit single-phase kit printed as KPRL3XGB24-1 in the PRL3a table (should presumably be KPRL3AGB24-1). Eaton has no web page for KPRL3AGB24-1, KPRL3ABA24-1, KPRL3AGB06-1, KPRL3AFD1 or KPRL3AED2.
SRC-00003 is dated 2017-10 but its local file docs/library/EAT/rp01400001e_2022_cl.pdf is the May 2022 edition (Z26214). Correct the source record.

log: B0013 Eaton mirror deep-dive (2026-10-21). (1) RP01400003E Feb 2013 (24 pp) downloaded from the Eaton-owned mirror http://cooperindustries.com/content/dam/eaton/.../eaton-vintage-cutler-hammer-swithboard-panelboard-rp01400003e-en-us.pdf (https on www.cooperindustries.com resets; plain http to cooperindustries.com works). All kit tables extracted: PB deadfront cover kits (99-3613-xx, PW..KT..NB), CH9CP, PH deadfront kits, PH cover plates 47-28xxx, KPH/KPH-L retrofit numbering, PH connector kits PH2CC1/PH6E-3/PH3CC3, PH-L/NFB filler 47-15718-2, EE2 plug-on unit numbering and EEFPB/EEFPS filler plates, KMP40 retrofit numbering, MP40 connector kits (14) with H hardware-only suffix, MP40FC/MP100FC fillers, M50 retrofit kits (16), TAD3, trim clamps 99-970/99-1016, trim locks. Dealer MP40 numbers reconciled (MP40ED225-3, MP40KL400-3, MP40CHH, MP403XBLANK are not OEM table numbers). (2) PL01400001E/2E/3E price lists: Wesco/Carlton-Bates 403, cooperindustries DAM guesses 404 - not obtained. (3) Pow-R-Line box/trim/enclosure tables mined from RP01400001E (May 2022 + Oct 2017, already in library) and Tab 22: EZ box/EZ trim (9 heights x 6 variants with 42C style numbers), YS boxes / LT trims, VWPB/LWPT Type 12/3R, PRL4 BX boxes, 6574C74Gxx vented covers, 6555Cxx side gutter covers, 8708C82 mounting channels, LDD door-in-door trims, RPCB/DPC Type 3R/12, PRL4 blank covers 6554C01/02 Hxx, LX column boxes/trims, PRL5P boxes/trims/doors, EZ trim locks 5155C81G04-06, 7499A48G04, PRL4 FDPW/FDPB fusible switches. (4) SPD: CA08100004E Oct 2022 obtained (integrated SPD numbering, application code A for PRL1a/2a/3a/3E direct bus). Eaton web shows PDSPD...-K3 (with KPRL3AFD3 provision kit) and -K4 (with KPRL4FD provision kit). (5) Eaton skuPages re-fetched for all ~917 EAT catalogue numbers plus new table numbers via cooperindustries.com/us/en-us/skuPage.<pn>.html; claims added for existing parts not covered by B0010 (UPC, Used with, ratings, listing, catalog notes, logistics data, active/discontinued banner). Discontinued banners found on KPRL4CA, BRS225, RABR20L125, RAABR12L125(A), RACH24L125I, RDCH42B200I, RTBR12L125R, RTBR10B100Q, several 1253C73/314C996/505C606/4212B7x/624B609/506C052/315C270 lug/terminal style numbers. No page exists for any KB*, KL*, KCDP*, KFDP*, MP40*, PH*, EE*, M50* number. (6) KPRL3A 100 vs 140 A: web value 140 A is uniform across BA, GB and F-frame kits and conflicts with RP limits (2 x 100 A devices for BA/GB, 2 x 150 A for F-frame, 200 A per connector); RP treated as governing. (7) Pow-R-Line C / i switchboard connector kits: none found.
